_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series Z1XYW/4 SET-1, Q.P. Code 31/4/1. 24 page images: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-4; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-22, Hindi on every odd index 3-21 (each the Hindi of the page after it); idx 23 (folio 24) is BLANK, the cover announces 23 printed pages. Odd-page tops checked: all Hindi (idx 13 opens with the Hindi Q29(B), idx 17 with the Hindi Q36(ii), read at full size; idx 19 with the Hindi Q37(iii)(A)). Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Printed instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 MCQ x1 (17-20 Assertion-Reason), B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4 (source based/case based). Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme for a bare OR: Q21, 22, 25, 29, 30, 32, 34, 37(iii), 38(iii), 39(iii) = 10 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper; Q23, 24, 26, 27, 28, 31, 33, 35, 36 carry none. Case-study labels on this paper are (i)/(ii)/(iii)(A) OR (iii)(B). All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each re-derived: all 20 agree (Q15 flagged as arguable). No void, grace or either-of-two note anywhere in the scheme (whole scheme read, ms idx 2-9; only conditional notes such as 'Deduct 1/2 mark if direction of rays is not marked' and 'Do not deduct marks for unbalanced equation'). Decimal points on this paper are ordinary full stops (Q13: 0.06A; Q39: 2.42, 1.5, 2.25), although the scheme prints raised ones. Q6's hydrates are printed with a baseline full stop (Na2CO3.10H2O, CaSO4. 1/2 H2O) and are written with the hydrate dot \cdot, the bank's convention. Q38(iii)(B)'s cross prints the phenotypes on a line under the genotypes; carried as parentheses after each genotype. Opener of series 31/4 for 2023: no reference paper, nothing skipped.
